scope: Bounded source review while upstream CI runs; not an exhaustive writer census or runtime proof

findings.boundary: delete_workspace wraps database deletion, then flushes deferred media effects after commit
findings.implication: An admission scoped only to Media.delete_file ends too early. The outer transaction owner must retain admission through deferred blob/rendition cleanup. Rollback and exceptions need explicit settlement or uncertainty.

findings.boundary: do_apply_mutations commits a batch before flushing deferred broadcasts; failures can enter compensating cleanup
findings.implication: Admission covers transaction outcome and all synchronous effects, including compensation. A generic after/finally checkin could erase uncertainty after partial effects.

findings.boundary: refresh_html_cache performs a revision-changing Repo.update inside a read and swallows failures
findings.implication: Held-mode readers must derive without persisting, or explicitly refuse. Testing only mutation routes misses this writer.

findings.boundary: after_media_upload calls Processing.process synchronously; processing writes content and renditions
findings.implication: The upload owner must hold admission through hooks and rendition effects, including errors converted to ordinary return values.

findings.boundary: Oban sweeper updates attempt state and invokes processing without a foreground request
findings.implication: It needs independent admission or explicit managed-mode disable/refusal. source:worker is not an exemption.

remaining: Enumerate direct document, schema, proposal, session, backfill, import, plugin and blob mutations reachable in the supported managed configuration
Bind startup, journal and database identity under exclusive host ownership; reject unsupported modes
Exercise real context and HTTP writes, deferred cleanup, commit/rollback, lost responses and restart against private database/blob fixtures
Keep the capability unavailable until complete writer coverage and recovery are demonstrated
